name: job-seeker-ops
description: Job-search tools that sit beside plainspeak-writer and resume-ops. Candidate positioning works out the case for one candidate and one posting before anything gets written, and saves it as one file that resume-ops and cover-letter read. Submission review has a separate reviewer read a finished cover letter, resume or outreach note the way its real reader will, without seeing how it was made, and return quoted findings with a verdict.
